spanish: Vale, vale. De una en una.

Have you learned to turn yet? | Have you learned to turn yet? | Can you turn yet?

spanish: Eres la sonda más antigua del programa.

Do you miss the launchpad? | Do you miss the launchpad? | Miss the launchpad?

spanish: Pequeño, no hace falta pitar en cada vuelta.

Okto, nice turn. | Okto, nice turn. | Good turn, Okto.
Did you calculate that all by yourself? | Did you calculate that all by yourself? | You worked that out on your own?

english: Okto, someone here says you're just a calculator. | Okto, someone here says you're just a calculator. | Okto, somebody called you a calculator.

spanish: Se lo diré. Con tus palabras.

spanish: ¿Nos ayudas con los deberes de mecánica orbital?

Okto, stop showing off. | Okto, stop showing off. | Enough showing off, Okto.
Your orbit is almost perfect. | Your orbit is almost perfect. | Nearly perfect orbit.

spanish: HECS, todo está bien. De verdad.
english: HECS, everything is fine. Really. | HECS, everything is fine. Really. | All fine, HECS. Honestly.

spanish: ¿Cuántas veces? No, no me lo digas.
english: How many times? No, don't tell me. | How many times? No, don't tell me. | How often? Never mind.

Just kidding! Just kidding! | Just kidding! Just kidding! | Joke! It was a joke!

It's not sarcasm. | It's not sarcasm. | Not sarcasm. Really.

Who's a good probe? You are! | Who's a good probe? You are! | Who's a good probe? You!

Go get that crater! | Go get that crater! | Fetch the crater!

Good morning, probe. | Good morning, probe. | Morning, probe.
Do you like the view? | Do you like the view? | Enjoying the view?
It's the whole of space. | It's the whole of space. | That's all of space.
We upgraded your antenna. | We upgraded your antenna. | Your antenna got an upgrade.
Want to say hi to the Stayputnik? | Want to say hi to the Stayputnik? | Say hello to the Stayputnik?

Hello, probe. | Hello, probe. | Hi, probe.

Everything normal up there? | Everything normal up there? | All normal up there?

english: Stayputnik, tell us about the old days. | Stayputnik, tell us about the old days. | Stayputnik, tell us about back then.
And you had no reaction wheels? | And you had no reaction wheels? | No reaction wheels at all?
Tough times. | Tough times. | Hard times.
Okto, what's our orbit? | Okto, what's our orbit? | Okto, orbit numbers?
Slower, please. | Slower, please. | Slow down.
HECS, status report. | HECS, status report. | Status, HECS.

That'll do. | That'll do. | Good enough.
Rovemate, do you want to go for a ride? | Rovemate, do you want to go for a ride? | Ride time, Rovemate?

One beep means yes? | One beep means yes? | One beep for yes?

english: We know. You told us yesterday. | We know. You told us yesterday. | You said that yesterday.

english: Yes, HECS, the checklist is up to date. | Yes, HECS, the checklist is up to date. | Checklist is current, HECS.

spanish: Lo hemos visto. Medio grado. Sobreviviremos.
english: We saw it. Half a degree. We'll survive. | We saw it. Half a degree. We'll survive. | Half a degree. We'll live.
Perfect report, HECS. As always. | Perfect report, HECS. As always. | Great report, HECS. Like always.
Is that a rock? Very nice. Leave it. | Is that a rock? Very nice. Leave it. | A rock? Lovely. Leave it.
We'll go for a ride later. | We'll go for a ride later. | Ride later.
What did you find? | What did you find? | Found something?
Yes, you're a good boy. | Yes, you're a good boy. | Good boy. Yes you are.

english: No, your excellency, no upgrade yet. | No, your excellency, no upgrade yet. | No upgrade yet, your excellency.

english: It's the same view as always. | It's the same view as always. | Same view as ever.

Hello to you too, probe. | Hello to you too, probe. | Hi to you too, probe.

english: We don't know the answer. Or the question. | We don't know the answer. Or the question. | No answer. No question either.
Copy. Both of them. | Copy. Both of them. | Copy. Both.
Was that a song? | Was that a song? | Did you just sing?
